objective: Independent label-concealed and score-blind review of 80 current Chinese valid/test positive candidates mixed with 80 frozen negative controls. Reviewers see raw pair evidence but no prior label, evidence tier, review conclusion, model score, or graph membership.
strict_positive_requirement: Shared seller-facing direct identifier or independently closed component/alias evidence. Template, topic, product, victim-data, public URL, and marketplace-support overlap are insufficient.
soft_positive_requirement: Strong structural/style/clone support without sufficient direct identity proof; may be used only in sensitivity analysis, never as strict gold.
hard_rules: Reviewers must not inspect Step7, Step9, Step15, Step17, or Step11 scores and predictions.
Reviewers must not see the previous review_label, evidence_type, paper_evidence_tier, recommended_use, confidence, rationale, reviewer_id, or review_notes fields.
No old conclusion-bearing review note may be copied into a reviewer queue.
Every queue row must include raw Step4 left/right previews so seller-facing context can be checked directly.
The aggregation script never modifies Step5 labels.
Every disagreement requires a separate adjudication decision with written evidence rationale.
